segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so for Northpoint I’ve got them at 64 seats to start, annual, $42,880 net after the 12% discount. They want a May 1 go-live, so pretty standard.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Did procurement push back on the auto-renewal or is it just pricing?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Mostly invoice timing. They need the first invoice dated May 3, net 30, because their April close is already locked. I put that note in the CRM and on the order form draft.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Eight hours onboarding, $1,600, not discounted. They asked if we could roll it into subscription, but I told them we need it as a separate line so finance can recognize it correctly.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Makes sense. What’s still open before signature?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Just the data processing addendum language. I’ve pinged legal and security twice since Tuesday for the redline approval, and the buyer basically has the deal parked until that comes back.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. If it’s still quiet by noon, I can ask Maya to look at the thread and see if it’s sitting with the right person.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’d help. The champion is ready, he even confirmed the admin list yesterday: 7 admins, 57 standard users, no contractors in phase one.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Once that approval hits, send the final through deal desk, and I’ll sanity-check the totals before you route it.
